runtime_build_provenance: 6f06e50 plus verified three-file statement-cache overlay; not rebuilt from 115cabc
cpu_counter_limitation: Derived CPU/success is retained, but raw per-cell cgroup before/after counter pairs are not. Raw/enriched load-generator records can be compared; CPU deltas cannot be independently reconstructed from retained counters.
per_response_validation: HTTP status200/nonempty body for every response; decoded populated content checked by per-arm preflight, not independently decoded for every timed response
cable_wire_rate: null for all24 measured non-deflate cases; unmeasured, not zero
http_wire_size: avg_bytes is mean response-body bytes on wire (gzip where served), excludes HTTP framing/headers; integer truncated by loadgen
memory_limitation: Peak memory is whole arm-run (HTTP/Cable/uploads), not per-route; process phase samples exclude kernel/socket memory
runtime_probe_scope: Separate pre-timing fresh-container smoke under same image/fixture/env/cpuset/nofile; no probes or runtime overlays during timing
